verdict.rationale: Belvo is an API-first product. Its docs show broad API coverage across aggregation, employment, payments, smart collections, fiscal and enrichment endpoints, plus a published OpenAPI spec page, Postman collections, programmatically configured webhooks, and MCP servers. Nothing in the pack states that UI or dashboard actions (e.g., the no-code solution, Connect widget customization, account and key management) are available through the API. missing for 10: explicit API–UI parity documentation, API coverage of dashboard/no-code features, a machine-retrievable OpenAPI file (probed paths 404), and independent corroboration of parity.
